notes: U3000 available as 1CH (F only) or 2CH (F/R), no interior cabin camera support
Distinguished from U3000 Pro by: no incabin_rec folder, ver.dat says 'U3000' not 'U3000PRO'
U3000 Pro supports 3CH variant with interior IR camera; U3000 does not
Firmware folder (u3000_0_<ver>/) only present after firmware update, not reliable for detection
Front channel has ~2.4x higher bitrate than rear channel (2CH variant)
Manual and SOS folders exist but were empty on sample card
